channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 31 Aug 2026
Pulitzer Center: Global South Civil Society Microgrants 2026
item.description: Pulitzer Center · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 to USD 4,000 per project. Applicants name the amount requested and submit a draft budget. Funds are transferred to the partner after the agreement is signed; partners file a financial narrative and outcomes report at the end but are NOT required to collect detailed receipts. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.
